A_cohort.note: 31 net-new post-freeze rows identified (the 08-14 reconciliation batch). After exclusion the cohort is 2 rows SHORT of the recorded 1,391: two freeze-time rows are missing from today's file, and v8's build never snapshotted the holdout event-id list, so they cannot be identified. Net cohort growth = +31 added, -2 lost = +29 (matches the 1,391 -> 1,420 delta).

coefficients.note: Coefficients do NOT reproduce within 1e-6 (max delta 0.010656). Root cause: Elo/trend/park/weather features for train-window rows are computed from the FULL history, and post-freeze backfills changed that history — v8's coefficients were fit on freeze-time feature values that no longer exist anywhere. Row-level probability drift is bounded (see row_probability_parity); exact coefficient reproduction requires the freeze-time dataset, which v8 never snapshotted. The frozen v9 feature table exists to prevent this class of drift for future models.
